title: PaymentInstrument
description: The instrument axis: what actually pays. The canonical model names an instrument, it never carries it — no pan, no token, no credential. Resolving this reference to something spendable is the Credential Provider's job, and in this project the Credential Provider is mocked and no real instrument is ever enrolled.

id.description: Identifier for the instrument, meaningful to the Credential Provider that holds it. Opaque everywhere else.

type.description: Instrument category, e.g. 'CARD' or 'BANK_ACCOUNT'. Deliberately an open string: the set of instrument categories is not ours to close, and an unknown category must be transportable rather than unrepresentable.

description.description: User-facing description, e.g. 'Visa ending 4242'. Shown on the Trusted Surface so the user can tell which instrument they are approving.
